question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **enjoy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"enjoy"** refers to taking delight or pleasure in an activity or occasion. (आनंद लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **They enjoy going to the beach on weekends.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that in order to maintain excellent health, we should eat in moderation. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word that fits best in the context is **'enjoy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **enjoy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **lose **(खो देना): To be deprived of or cease to have something.

 
 
• **Example:** He didn't want to lose the game.
 
 
 
• **benefit **(लाभ): An advantage or profit gained from something.
 
 
• **Example: **Regular exercise has many health benefits.
 
 
 
• **reward** (इनाम): A thing given in recognition of service, effort, or achievement.
 
 
• **Example:** She received a reward for her excellent performance.
